question: Should ClawHub adopt noun-first `skill` and `package` command groups with compatibility aliases for existing top-level skill commands, or preserve the current mixed top-level workflow surface?
rationale: The current `package` group intentionally represents a unified catalog while the requested `skills` group would rename established automation-facing commands; source evidence cannot choose the public long-term contract or compatibility window.

options.title: Namespace with aliases
options.body: Introduce explicit `skill` and `package` groups while preserving existing top-level skill commands as documented aliases through a defined deprecation period.

options.title: Preserve current surface
options.body: Keep existing top-level skill workflows and the `package` catalog namespace, improving help grouping only if needed.

options.title: Move without aliases
options.body: Make noun-first groups canonical immediately and accept a breaking CLI change in the next major release.

recommendation.title: Namespace with aliases
recommendation.body: Introduce explicit `skill` and `package` groups while preserving existing top-level skill commands as documented aliases through a defined deprecation period.
